description: Hi! I'm Chi (Aero Engineering, HUST), alongside Son and My Anh (IT & CS, UET). We are utterly captivated by astrophysics, orbital mechanics, and the breathtaking mysteries of the deep cosmos. For this NASA challenge, we aren't just building a project; we are hunting for kindred spirits who share our burning, relentless obsession with space exploration. Let's unite our boundless passion for the universe, combine our technical minds, and build something legendary! 🚀
